scenes.text: Sea level marker 1: a point is 1 metres above sea level. Write its signed height. Let us think carefully. Above zero is positive; below zero is negative. The answer is 1. Great work!
Sea level marker 2: a point is 2 metres below sea level. Write its signed height. Let us think carefully. Above zero is positive; below zero is negative. The answer is -2. Great work!
Sea level marker 3: a point is 3 metres above sea level. Write its signed height. Let us think carefully. Above zero is positive; below zero is negative. The answer is 3. Great work!
Sea level marker 4: a point is 4 metres below sea level. Write its signed height. Let us think carefully. Above zero is positive; below zero is negative. The answer is -4. Great work!
